message.content: {"tender_id":"ERP-PROC-2026-08","page_number":6,"extracted_clauses":[{"clause_code":"FIN_TURNOVER","clause_title":"Minimum Annual Turnover","text_verbatim":"The bidder must have an average annual financial turnover of at least INR 5.00 Crores over the last 3 financial years.","standard_category":"FINANCIAL_TURNOVER","comparator":"MIN_REQUIRED","numeric_threshold":5.00,"unit":"INR_CRORE"},{"clause_code":"EMD_REQ","clause_title":"Earnest Money Deposit","text_verbatim":"Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) of INR 4.50 Lakhs shall be submitted via BG/DD.","standard_category":"EARNEST_MONEY_DEPOSIT","comparator":"MAX_ALLOWED","numeric_threshold":4.50,"unit":"INR_LAKH"},{"clause_code":"EXP_GOV","clause_title":"Government PSU Experience","text_verbatim":"Bidder must possess at least 3 years of prior experience in implementing enterprise ERP solutions for Central/State Government PSUs.","standard_category":"PAST_EXPERIENCE","comparator":"MIN_REQUIRED","numeric_threshold":3.00,"unit":"YEARS"},{"clause_code":"ISO_QUALITY","clause_title":"Quality Standards Certification","text_verbatim":"Bidder must hold valid ISO 9001:2015 and ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certifications as on bid submission date.","standard_category":"ISO_CERTIFICATION","comparator":"REQUIRED_SET","numeric_threshold":null,"unit":"BOOLEAN"}]}
